name: Hi no Hikari no Shita de 2 Yuzu no Baai
original_name: 日の光の下で2 ゆずの場合
source:
Yuzu was bullied for two years by a boy in class.
She wished she could escape it all, but if she did, the bully would tease her friend.
But now Yuzu has a solution.
What that is, and whether it can work, remains to be seen.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE136108.html]DLsite English[/url]]
